person_note: The diagnostic quotes show third-person focalized narration around several characters, with q00992 additionally revealing an external narrator's future knowledge. The authorized prologue independently sustains the same form across multiple focal characters, and the whole-book analysis explicitly confirms omniscient third-person perspective shifts. First-person forms occur only in dialogue, while visible you forms are generic maxims, speech, or locally quoted thought; there is no evidence of sustained first- or second-person base sections. The main limitation is that the primary web text covers only the opening, but the interior-style quote evidence and whole-book structural description agree without credible conflict.
